viewport_notes: mobile: buy box reachable, sticky ATC a plus, variant/bundle chips don't overflow. desktop: gallery+buy-box side-by-side.

checks.rule: product image + title + price + Add-to-Cart all visible above the fold in the rest frame (NOT obscured by any modal/banner)
price prominent; ATC the clear primary action; title is the H1
nothing past the right edge; variant/bundle selectors don't overflow
supporting sections (ingredients/reviews/ritual/FAQ) sit BELOW the buy box in the recipe order — never above it
deliberate gaps; no cramped collisions, no desolate voids
no missing-image placeholders, no Liquid errors, no empty shells, no Lorem/[CLAIM] text, no copy typos in rendered text
consent/announcement chrome on-brand AND not covering any buy-box control
intentional premium per the niche scorecard, not a generic demo
